english.notes: From 20th October 2014 the power to make a dog control order under section 55 of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 is repealed. The repeal does not, however, apply in relation to an order made before that date or anything done in connection with such an order. As such, this offence can still be committed in relation to the proposed issuing of a fixed penalty for committing an offence under a dog control order made before 20th October 2014.
